title: Stepper
description: − value + for a small count (quantities, copies, seats) in a workspace panel or a card: one tap per step, a unit after the value, min and max.
when: A small whole number people nudge rather than type: tấn per line, copies, guests, 1–99.
Inside a WorkspaceSection or a line card of a request.

instead.need: A number people type (price, weight with decimals, a large count)
A value on a continuous range

a11y: The value is a spinbutton (aria-valuenow / min / max, aria-valuetext with the unit) named by label: ↑ / → and ↓ / ← step, Page Up / Page Down move ten steps, Home / End go to min / max.
The − + buttons are named (“Giảm …”, “Tăng …”) and left out of the Tab order: the keys do the same, so Tab reaches one stop per stepper.
